$comment: TF-110 soak guards read by multiclient.py --soak-seconds. PROVISIONAL harness guards with headroom for shared-host noise, not SLOs (GameModules/SparkGameMMOFPS/DESIGN.md section 8). Tick numbers come from tf_perf (Utils/TFPerfCounters.h): maxTickAvgP95Ms bounds the 95th percentile of the ~2 s mean tick sampled every sampleIntervalS, maxTickPeakMs bounds the sum of per-phase peaks since the previous sample (an upper bound on the worst single tick). bots is the PR-lane count: 32 bots plus two clients are 34 actors. The 30-minute run overrides it with --soak-bots 98 (kTFMaxBots) for 100 actors, the W4 perf pass target. The tf_bots console command (TFCommandsGameplay.cpp) now accepts counts up to kTFMaxBots, but no run has verified that 98 bots spawn or replicate; the thresholds stay provisional until measured on a hosted runner.
